scripts.format:changed: (git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z && git diff --name-only --diff-filter=d -z HEAD) | xargs -0 vp fmt --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern
scripts.clean: find . -type d \( -name dist -o -name node_modules -o -name .vite -o -name .turbo -o -name .next -o -name .output -o -name .nuxt -o -name .react-router -o -name .open-next -o -name .source -o -name .svelte-kit \) -prune -exec rm -rf {} + -o -name tsconfig.tsbuildinfo -o -name coverage.json -exec rm -f {} +
scripts.update:canary: vp list -r | grep fragno | cut -d' ' -f1 | sort -u | xargs -I {} vp update {}@canary -r
scripts.update:fragno: vp list -r | grep fragno | cut -d' ' -f1 | sort -u | xargs -I {} vp update {}@latest -r
